reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and getWeekendAdjustedDay, but not the occurrence-to-final-day policy, which it re-derives instead of extracting it from getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The skipsDailyWeekend computation, the daily-weekend filter and the getWeekendAdjustedDay call with skipWeekend && !skipsDailyWeekend are copied almost verbatim from getUpcomingDates (and mirror getNextDate in shared/schedules.ts), making a third copy of the rule.

placement.why: The handler sits beside getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered like the others; the occurrence-adjustment policy would better live as a shared function in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type entry, needed imports and tests.

maintainability.why: A future change to how daily weekend occurrences are skipped or adjusted must now be made in three places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing getWeekendAdjustedDay and recurConfigToRSchedule helpers; there is no shared occurrence-adjustment helper to bypass, though one should have been extracted.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied block in getDatesInRange (skipsDailyWeekend + filter + getWeekendAdjustedDay) is an open near-verbatim copy of getUpcomingDates, rewritten as a loop but not disguised.
